title: CASB: ZIA inline controls plus out-of-band SaaS security, not one product

prose.text: The inline path is a Zscaler Admin Console menu: {{casb-inline-path}} Out-of-band scanning of data at rest in sanctioned SaaS applications is a ZIA surface [[zia.casb:scans-saas-data-at-rest]], and inline cloud app rules are in [[zia.cloud-app-control]].

Whether the inline feature set is Cloud App Control, Tenant Profiles, SaaS application visibility and in-line DLP is open {{gap:casb-inline-list}}. Whether CASB is sold as a standalone SKU is open {{gap:casb-sku}}. Whether out-of-band CASB runs through DSPM and the SaaS Security Report is open {{gap:casb-oob}}. Whether Zscaler markets a Multi-Mode CASB as part of its Data Security platform is open {{gap:casb-data-security}}.

Data at rest in cloud and on-premises stores is covered by [[dspm.overview]], and shadow IT discovery by [[portfolio.saas-security-report]]. Third-party apps connected to SaaS platforms: [[zia.app-governance]].

checks.do: Route a CASB question by what the customer needs: inline policy on cloud apps to ZIA Cloud App Control, scanning of data at rest in sanctioned SaaS to ZIA CASB, data at rest in stores to DSPM, and shadow IT discovery to the SaaS Security Report.

casb-inline-path.statement: In the Zscaler Admin Console, the navigation for SaaS and cloud app policy is Data Security > Inline CASB > SaaS/Cloud App Policy.

quotes: To view the supported cloud applications for a cloud app category from the Zscaler Admin Console:
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > Inline CASB > SaaS/Cloud App Policy.

casb-sku.title: Whether CASB is sold as a standalone SKU
casb-sku.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'CASB sits outside the tier system because Zscaler markets CASB capabilities as part of two existing products rather than as a standalone CASB SKU ... Zscaler's CASB story is the federation of those product surfaces.' No captured page says CASB is or is not sold as a SKU. The vendored Python and Go SDK trees have no casb package, but the legacy statement that this is intentional is not captured.

casb-oob.title: Whether DSPM or the SaaS Security Report also delivers out-of-band CASB
casb-oob.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Out-of-band CASB (also called API CASB / SaaS Security Posture) is delivered through DSPM / SaaS Security Report.' The captured help places SaaS Security data-at-rest scanning under ZIA (zia.casb:scans-saas-data-at-rest); no captured page says DSPM or the SaaS Security Report delivers it.

casb-inline-list.title: Which features make up ZIA's inline CASB
casb-inline-list.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Inline CASB is delivered through ZIA: Cloud App Control (CAC), Tenant Profiles, SaaS application visibility, in-line DLP for cloud apps.' The ZIA capture supports an Inline CASB admin menu (claim casb-inline-path) and separate articles on tenant profiles and cloud app rules, but does not list these four as the inline CASB feature set.

casb-data-security.title: Whether Zscaler markets a Multi-Mode CASB as part of its Data Security platform
casb-data-security.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'DSPM is integrated with Zscaler's broader Data Security platform: Web/Email DLP, Endpoint DLP, Multi-Mode CASB, Unified SaaS Security' and 'Native integration with ZIA / ZPA / DLP / CASB'. The earlier non-verbatim capture of the DSPM page said this; the current capture of the page says DSPM is natively integrated with the Zscaler Data Security platform and does not mention CASB.
